column1: # Idempotent setup for agent tools that are not plain npm packages or skills.
# name<TAB>done-when (shell test; the step is skipped when it succeeds)<TAB>run (shell)
# Installers go to ~/.local/bin, which is on PATH, so none of them need sudo.
# AXI ambient-context hooks for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode (bare command names, portable).
# herdr agent-state hooks; the Claude one is referenced by home/.claude/settings.json.
# compact-adviser (Jev) for Claude Code; its Pi package is pinned in home/.pi/agent/settings.json.

column2: claude plugin marketplace list | grep -q compact-adviser
